cwe_content.cwe: CWE-79,Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

candidate.Reason: The appendTo method directly appends key.toString() to JSON output without proper HTML encoding. If variable names contain malicious JavaScript, it will be directly injected into the HTML output when the JSON index is rendered.

This method processes variable names to create n-gram indexes without sanitization. Malicious JavaScript in variable names will be processed and included in the index data that gets passed to appendTo() for JSON generation.

This method collects variables from external sources (including user-controlled variables) and processes them without sanitization. The variables are passed to buildNGramIndex() which creates the vulnerable index data.
